hints.title: Reverse Order Direction
hints.text: Working backwards from the destination to index 1 lets ties favor the lowest jump index automatically.

hints.title: State Definition
hints.text: Let cost[i] be the minimum cost to reach index n starting from index i. If coins[i] is negative one, index i is unreachable.

hints.title: Next Jump Tracking
hints.text: For each index i from n minus one down to zero, check all valid landing positions j up to i plus maxJump. Record the jump j that minimizes total cost, breaking ties by choosing the smaller index j.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Backward dynamic programming ensures lexicographical tie-breaking without full path string comparisons.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Forward search with ties requires comparing entire path suffix lexicographically.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Solving backwards from n to 1 automatically prioritizes smaller next indices during ties.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Iterate from right to left so that equal cost choices naturally pick the smallest index.
